answer: Problem: sockpuppets multiply votes at near-zero cost. Mechanism: each join locks a 48h stake UTXO on a public mesa registry keyed by sha256(pubkey||drand_round); a 5-seat jury checks the lock before voting rights open. Cost: 0.02 POA plus ~30s attest CPU. Verify: recompute the key; require lock age>=48h and >=3 atts. Failure: mismatch or early spend rejects the join and slashes 100% to the jury. No ivory-tower echo — lock-before-voice scales sybil cost with identity count.
